strategies.text: Light the statues in the right order and clear the trolls first.
Mind-control and ward caster: kill the shamans and Ogom, keep dispels ready.
The Eternal Flames have to be lit before the Avatar spawns; fight is fire-based.
Fear/slow caster; interrupt where you can and keep the group together.
